trustSecurity.shared.contact.heading: Contact
trustSecurity.privacy.overview.heading: Overview
trustSecurity.privacy.overview.p1: At Alfred, protecting your privacy is fundamental to our mission.
trustSecurity.privacy.overview.p2: Alfred is designed to help leaders organize their work, develop their leadership, and reflect on their professional growth. To provide these services, Alfred stores and processes information that you choose to share with the platform.
trustSecurity.privacy.overview.p3: We are committed to handling your data responsibly, transparently, and securely.
trustSecurity.privacy.collect.heading: Information We Collect
trustSecurity.privacy.collect.intro: Depending on how you use Alfred, we may collect:
trustSecurity.privacy.collect.b1: Account information, such as your name, email address, and authentication details.
trustSecurity.privacy.collect.b2: Goals, tasks, habits, journal entries, and leadership reflections.
trustSecurity.privacy.collect.b3: Team and stakeholder information that you choose to enter.
trustSecurity.privacy.collect.b6: Device information required to operate the application.
trustSecurity.privacy.use.heading: How We Use Your Information
trustSecurity.privacy.use.b6: Protect against fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access.
trustSecurity.privacy.ai.heading: AI Processing
trustSecurity.privacy.ai.p1: Alfred uses artificial intelligence to generate coaching responses, reflections, summaries, and recommendations.
trustSecurity.privacy.ai.p2: Your prompts and responses may be securely processed by trusted AI providers solely to provide the requested functionality.
trustSecurity.privacy.ai.p3: We do not use your personal data to train Alfred's own AI models.
trustSecurity.privacy.storage.heading: Data Storage
trustSecurity.privacy.storage.p1: Your information is stored using modern cloud infrastructure.
trustSecurity.privacy.storage.p2: Reasonable technical and organizational safeguards are implemented to protect your information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
trustSecurity.privacy.children.heading: Children's Privacy
trustSecurity.privacy.children.p1: Alfred is not intended for children under 13, and users must be at least 13 years old to create or use an account.
trustSecurity.privacy.children.p2: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided information to Alfred, contact us so that we can review and delete it as appropriate.
trustSecurity.privacy.rights.heading: Your Rights
trustSecurity.privacy.rights.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request to:
trustSecurity.privacy.contact.p1: Questions regarding privacy can be sent to:
trustSecurity.terms.acceptance.heading: Acceptance
trustSecurity.terms.acceptance.p1: By using Alfred, you agree to these Terms of Service.
trustSecurity.terms.eligibility.heading: Eligibility
trustSecurity.terms.eligibility.p1: You must be at least 13 years old to create or use an Alfred account.
trustSecurity.terms.eligibility.p2: If you are under the age of majority where you live, you must have permission from a parent or legal guardian to use Alfred.
trustSecurity.terms.intended.heading: Intended Use
trustSecurity.terms.intended.p1: Alfred is a productivity, leadership development, and AI coaching platform intended to support personal and professional growth.
trustSecurity.terms.intended.p2: Alfred is not intended to replace professional legal, medical, psychological, financial, or employment advice.
trustSecurity.terms.responsibilities.b1: Maintaining the security of their account.
trustSecurity.terms.responsibilities.b4: Respecting intellectual property and confidentiality obligations.
trustSecurity.terms.responsibilities.b5: Using Alfred in a responsible and professional manner.
trustSecurity.terms.availability.heading: Availability
trustSecurity.terms.availability.p1: We strive to provide a reliable service, but we cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability.
trustSecurity.terms.availability.p2: Features may evolve, change, or be discontinued over time as Alfred improves.
trustSecurity.terms.ai.heading: AI Disclaimer
trustSecurity.terms.ai.p1: AI-generated responses are intended to assist reflection, planning, prioritization, and decision-making.
trustSecurity.terms.ai.p2: Final decisions remain the responsibility of the user.
trustSecurity.terms.ip.heading: Intellectual Property
trustSecurity.terms.ip.p1: The Alfred software, design, branding, educational content, and leadership curriculum remain the property of Alfred unless otherwise stated.
trustSecurity.terms.userContent.heading: User Content
trustSecurity.terms.userContent.p1: You retain ownership of the content you enter into Alfred.
trustSecurity.terms.userContent.p2: By using the service, you grant Alfred the limited right to process that content only as needed to provide the service.
trustSecurity.terms.termination.heading: Termination
trustSecurity.terms.termination.p1: Users may stop using Alfred at any time.
trustSecurity.terms.termination.p2: Accounts that violate these Terms may be suspended or terminated.
trustSecurity.security.principles.p1: Security is a core design principle of Alfred.
trustSecurity.security.principles.p2: We recognize that leaders may store sensitive professional reflections, goals, people notes, and strategic information inside the platform.
trustSecurity.security.infrastructure.p1: Alfred uses secure cloud infrastructure to operate the service.
trustSecurity.security.infrastructure.p2: Data is encrypted during transmission using HTTPS/TLS.
trustSecurity.security.authentication.p1: User authentication is protected using modern authentication practices.
trustSecurity.security.authentication.p2: Passwords are never stored in plain text.
trustSecurity.security.monitoring.p1: Alfred includes system health monitoring, audit logs, and operational review workflows to help identify reliability or security issues.
trustSecurity.security.monitoring.p2: Monitoring is designed to support product safety while minimizing unnecessary access to customer information.
trustSecurity.security.ai.heading: AI Providers
trustSecurity.security.ai.p1: When AI services are used, data is transmitted only to trusted providers required to generate the requested response or insight.
trustSecurity.security.access.heading: Access Control
trustSecurity.security.access.p1: Access to production systems and sensitive operational information should be restricted to authorized administrators.
trustSecurity.security.improvements.head: Security Improvements
trustSecurity.security.improvements.p1: Alfred's security posture will continue to evolve as the product matures, including stronger auditability, access controls, backup readiness, and operational hardening.
trustSecurity.security.disclosure.p1: If you discover a security vulnerability, please contact:
trustSecurity.gdpr.commitment.heading: Our Commitment
trustSecurity.gdpr.commitment.p1: Alfred respects applicable privacy regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation, where applicable.
trustSecurity.gdpr.commitment.p2: We aim to give users transparency and control over their personal information.
trustSecurity.gdpr.controller.heading: Data Controller
trustSecurity.gdpr.controller.p1: Alfred acts as the controller for information you provide directly within the application.
trustSecurity.gdpr.processor.heading: Data Processor
trustSecurity.gdpr.processor.p1: Alfred may use trusted infrastructure, hosting, database, analytics, communication, and AI providers to operate the service.
trustSecurity.gdpr.processor.p2: These providers process data only as required to deliver Alfred's functionality.
trustSecurity.gdpr.rights.heading: Your Rights
trustSecurity.gdpr.rights.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request:
trustSecurity.gdpr.rights.b4: Deletion of your account or data.
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.heading: Account and Data Deletion
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.p1: You can request deletion of your Alfred account and associated personal data at any time.
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.p2: Signed-in users can initiate account deletion directly from Settings under Privacy & Data. If you cannot access your account, you may also contact Alfred from the address associated with your account.
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.p3: Once verified, Alfred will delete account information and user-created content such as goals, tasks, habits, journal entries, leadership reflections, team notes, AI coaching conversations, and related profile data, unless limited retention is required for legal, security, fraud-prevention, or operational recordkeeping purposes.
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.b1: Send your request to alfredchiefofstaff@gmail.com with the subject: Delete my Alfred account.
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.b2: We may ask for information needed to verify account ownership before deleting data.
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.b3: Deletion requests are processed as promptly as reasonably possible after verification.
trustSecurity.gdpr.deletion.emailLabel: Email alfredchiefofstaff@gmail.com to request account deletion
trustSecurity.gdpr.retention.heading: Data Retention
trustSecurity.gdpr.retention.p1: Your data is retained only as long as necessary to provide the service, support legitimate operational needs, or satisfy legal obligations.
trustSecurity.gdpr.retention.p2: Deleted accounts are removed according to Alfred's retention policies.
trustSecurity.gdpr.transfers.heading: International Transfers
trustSecurity.gdpr.transfers.p1: Where applicable, information may be processed using trusted infrastructure providers operating internationally while applying appropriate safeguards.
trustSecurity.gdpr.contact.p1: For privacy or GDPR-related requests, contact:
trustSecurity.support.help.heading: Get Help
trustSecurity.support.help.p1: For help with account access, app functionality, recordings, transcripts, or other technical issues, contact Alfred Support:
trustSecurity.support.details.heading: What to Include
trustSecurity.support.details.p1: To help us investigate efficiently, include:
trustSecurity.support.details.b1: Your device model and operating system version.
trustSecurity.support.details.b2: The Alfred app version and build number shown in TestFlight or the App Store.
trustSecurity.support.details.b3: A concise description of what happened and the steps that led to it.
trustSecurity.support.details.b4: A screenshot of the error when appropriate, without passwords or confidential meeting content.
trustSecurity.support.privacy.heading: Privacy and Account Deletion
trustSecurity.support.privacy.p1: Signed-in users can delete their account from Settings under Privacy & Data. For privacy questions or help when you cannot access your account, contact:
trustSecurity.cookies.overview.heading: Overview
trustSecurity.cookies.overview.p1: Alfred uses cookies and similar technologies to operate the application and improve the user experience.
trustSecurity.cookies.why.heading: Why We Use Cookies
trustSecurity.cookies.why.b5: Understand usage patterns where analytics are enabled.
trustSecurity.cookies.essential.heading: Essential Cookies
trustSecurity.cookies.essential.p1: Some cookies are required for Alfred to function properly.
trustSecurity.cookies.essential.p2: These may support authentication, session management, security, and user preferences.
trustSecurity.cookies.analytics.heading: Analytics Cookies
trustSecurity.cookies.analytics.p1: Where analytics are enabled, Alfred may collect usage information to improve the product.
trustSecurity.cookies.analytics.p2: Analytics should be configured to minimize unnecessary personal data collection.
trustSecurity.cookies.managing.heading: Managing Cookies
trustSecurity.cookies.managing.p1: Most browsers allow you to control cookies through browser settings.
trustSecurity.cookies.managing.p2: Disabling certain cookies may affect Alfred's functionality.
trustSecurity.cookies.contact.p1: Questions about cookies can be sent to:
